jobs.description: Titre du poste: Stagiaire - Programmation graphique - Beenox (Hiver 2027) Identifiant de demande de poste: R027941 Description du poste: Stagiaire Programmation Graphique – Beenox (Hiver 2027) * À noter que ce stage aura lieu à l’hiver 2027. Ce poste est basé dans nos bureaux de Québec et suit un mode de travail en présentiel de cinq jours par semaine. Les modalités de travail peuvent évoluer en fonction des besoins de l’entreprise. Fondé à Québec et poursuivant sa croissance avec une équipe à Montréal, Beenox possède plus de 25 ans d’expertise en développement de jeux. En tant que studio d'Activision, nous sommes leaders dans le divertissement interactif et impliqués dans la création de titres renommés. C’est avec fierté que nous contribuons grandement à la célèbre franchise Call of Duty, notamment par la création de contenu sur les saisons de Warzone et en dirigeant le développement de la version PC de Call of Duty. À travers notre histoire, nous avons également participé au succès de Crash Bandicoot, Tony Hawk's Pro Skater, Skylanders, Spider-Man et Guitar Hero. Notre raison d’être est de propulser les gens à forger des relations et à vivre l’exaltation de se surpasser ensemble, jour après jour. Nous sommes déterminés.es dans notre mission d'élever des expériences de jeux emblématiques à des niveaux inégalés, pour tous les joueurs.euses. En tant que stagiaire en programmation au sein de notre équipe graphique chez Beenox, vous intégrerez l'équipe spécialisée dans le moteur de rendu, travaillant sur des franchises d'envergure mondiale telles que Call of Duty. Vous participerez au développement, à l'optimisation et à l'outillage des technologies de rendu propriétaires du studio. Ce stage vous offrira une expérience concrète au cœur de la production de jeux AAA, combinant résolution de problèmes complexes, optimisation des performances et travail d'équipe multidisciplinaire. Vos responsabilités principales • Outils & pipelines de production : Concevoir, améliorer et automatiser les outils internes de développement, de débogage et de visualisation utilisés au quotidien par l'équipe graphique et les équipes artistiques. • Télémétrie & analyse de données : Développer des tableaux de bord et des pipelines de collecte de données de performance provenant des consoles et du PC, afin d'outiller les décisions techniques de l'équipe. • Résolution de bugs & débogage avancé : Diagnostiquer, analyser et corriger des problèmes techniques complexes, des fuites de mémoire ou des artefacts visuels dans la base de code existante. • Optimisation & performance : Identifier les goulots d'étranglement (CPU, GPU, mémoire vidéo, temps de frame, nombre d'appels de rendu) et exécuter des travaux d'optimisation pour garantir la fluidité sur différentes architectures logicielles et matérielles. • Développement du moteur de rendu : Participer à l'implémentation et à l'amélioration de sous-systèmes de rendu en C++ (éclairage, ombres, post-traitement, effets visuels, matériaux/shaders). • Collaboration interdisciplinaire : Travailler étroitement avec les programmeurs graphiques seniors, les artistes techniques (Technical Artists) et les équipes d'art et de design pour répondre aux besoins techniques et intégrer efficacement de nouvelles fonctionnalités. Le mandat exact est défini en début de stage selon vos intérêts et les besoins de l'équipe. Aucune expertise préalable en programmation graphique n'est requise : vous serez encadré.e par des programmeurs.euses graphiques seniors. Exigences de base • Formation : Étudiant(e) actif(ve) dans un programme universitaire en génie logiciel, informatique, génie informatique, mathématiques appliquées ou une discipline connexe. • Maîtrise du C++ : Solide compréhension du langage C++ (gestion de la mémoire, pointeurs, structures de données, programmation orientée objet). • Bases en architecture logicielle : Connaissance des concepts de programmation de bas niveau, du multithreading et des principes fondamentaux de l'ingénierie logicielle. • Résolution de problèmes : Capacités d'analyse rigoureuses et aisance avec le débogage de code complexe. • Esprit d'équipe : Bonnes aptitudes de communication et volonté de collaborer dans un environnement agile et dynamique. • Expérience avec jeu de tir à la première personne (FPS) Atout • Bases en mathématiques appliquées : algèbre linéaire (vecteurs, matrices, transformations) et géométrie 3D. • Notions d'informatique graphique : pipelines de rendu modernes (rastérisation, ray tracing, compute shaders) et architectures GPU. • Compréhension des API graphiques modernes (DirectX, Vulkan, OpenGL) ou des architectures de consoles de jeu. • Expérience pratique avec un moteur de jeu (propriétaire, Unreal Engine, Unity) ou des projets personnels (rendu 3D, moteurs personnels). • Connaissance du langage C# ou de langages de script (Python). • Expérience en développement d'outils ou en visualisation de données. • Portfolio ou compte GitHub présentant des projets de programmation de bas niveau ou de jeux vidéo.

jobs.description: Perplexity is hiring an experienced Communications & Marketing Recruiter to help build the teams responsible for how our company and products are positioned, launched, explained, and experienced. You will lead searches across Communications, Marketing, Social, Editorial, Content, Events and related functions. These disciplines require different networks and different ways of evaluating talent. A strong product marketer may need deep technical fluency and launch experience. A communications leader may be judged by the quality of their counsel and writing. A growth marketer needs to show measurable business impact. This is a hands-on, full-cycle recruiting role. You will work closely with Communications and Marketing leaders to define each search, build the market, assess candidates, and close the people who can raise the quality of the work. You should be comfortable reading portfolios and writing samples, digging into campaign results, and separating individual contribution from team output. You will also help us use AI more effectively across recruiting. That means applying it to research, talent mapping, outreach, and workflow automation while maintaining a high bar for judgment and candidate experience. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own full-cycle recruiting across the Communications & Marketing team. - Partner with Communications and Marketing leaders from intake through close. Turn early or ambiguous briefs into clear candidate profiles, interview plans, and sourcing strategies. - Build talent maps across technology companies, consumer brands, enterprise software, media organizations, and agencies. - Develop sourcing strategies specific to each discipline. Know where strong writers, communications operators, product marketers, and performance-minded marketers build their reputations. - Evaluate candidates beyond titles and company names. Review portfolios and writing samples, understand campaign context, clarify individual ownership, and probe for measurable results. - Help hiring teams build structured work-sample and portfolio reviews that reflect the actual work of each role. - Give leaders direct, useful reads on pipeline quality, candidate tradeoffs, compensation, and the state of the market. - Represent Perplexity clearly and credibly. Explain the product, the pace of the company, and the opportunity without relying on a generic AI pitch. - Run a thoughtful candidate process from first conversation through close, including senior candidates with competing offers and high expectations for the recruiting experience. - Use AI tools for research, sourcing, outreach, and recruiting operations. Identify where automation improves speed and where recruiter judgment needs to stay central. - Track pipeline health and search performance, identify gaps early, and adjust the strategy before a search stalls. WHAT YOU BRING - 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including meaningful depth across Communications and Marketing. - Experience hiring across several of the following areas: Product Marketing, Corporate or Executive Communications, Editorial, Content, Social Media, Brand, Growth, Demand Generation, Field Marketing, or Events. - A track record of partnering closely with senior Communications or Marketing leaders on important and difficult searches. - Strong functional judgment. You understand the differences between product marketing, communications, editorial, brand, growth, and field marketing, including which backgrounds transfer well between them. - Comfort evaluating portfolios, writing samples, campaign work, and business results alongside the hiring team. - Strong writing and communication skills. You can sharpen a search brief, write credible outreach, and communicate clearly with candidates and executives. - Experience recruiting in a high-growth startup or similarly fast-moving environment. - Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve sourcing, research, outreach, or recruiting workflows. - Fluency with modern ATS and recruiting systems. Experience with Ashby is preferred. - Sound judgment, attention to detail, and the willingness to push back when the market or candidate evidence does not support the original brief. - The ability to manage several distinct searches without giving candidates or hiring teams a generic experience.

jobs.description: Overview The Opportunity The Brand and Customer Experience Design team creates meaningful connections between brands and customers—bridging our portfolio and our consumers to develop innovative ways to engage people, make an impact, and leave a lasting mark. Our work begins with a sketch, evolves into a script, and ultimately becomes whatever medium tells the story best. As the Senior Design Manager, Immersive Branding, you will have an extraordinary opportunity to shape brand narratives through mixed media. Your role will focus on crafting compelling and immersive brand experiences across social, cultural, digital, and metaphysical landscapes. You are a visionary in all creative workstreams, collaborating with leadership, cross-functional teams, and partners to deliver world-class creative work every day. Why Experience Design? The Brand and Customer Experience Design team is an architect of unforgettable moments, crafting immersive brand experiences that resonate deeply with audiences around the globe. Our mission is to blend innovative ideas, culinary expertise, and strategic insights to transform dimensional spaces, unlock the consumer mindset, and establish a strong connection between our brands and our customers. From executives to leaders on the frontline, we’re excited about the future. We take chances. Together, we dare to make the world a better place. Our associates are the magic ingredient. Each of them plays an integral role in helping create deep connections between people and our products. Think about your last group celebration: Chances are, one of our iconic brands was by your side. At PepsiCo, you’re invited to be a part of a global team of innovators who make, move, and sell these products—which are enjoyed by more than 1 billion people a day. A career at PepsiCo means working in a culture where everyone’s invited. Here, you can dare to be yourself. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you can influence the people around you and the world at large. By showing up, you’ll have the opportunity learn, develop, and grow our unique skill sets at work. Our supportive teams can fuel your professional goals to make a global impact. Join us. Dare for Better. Why PepsiCo Design? At PepsiCo design, we have a saying: “We’re crazy enough to think we can inspire the future.” This is what drives us, in everything we imagine, develop and execute. Design is a strategic global function for PepsiCo that drives business value by leading innovation, creating experiences, and brand engagements. We are one of the first major food & beverage companies to integrate multiple design disciplines—brand design, design thinking, industrial design, design strategy, front-end innovation—into a single group. Our goal is clear: to connect PepsiCo’s food & beverage portfolios, with today’s hyper-connected, networked users and consumers hungry for meaningful, authentic, and relevant brand experiences across multiple touchpoints and regions of the world. Why Experience Design? Experience Design creates transformative, dimensional spaces that manifest a brand’s story in an immersive yet expansive way, forging bold new connections with consumers. We inspire the future! Creative Leadership – Lead, manage, and mentor designers across multiple workstreams, driving excellence in transformative and immersive experiences. Experiential Design – Oversee the design and execution of brands in the physical and digital brand experiences, ensuring they deliver memorable, immersive interactions that engage consumers. Strategic Program & Campaign Execution – Balance long-term growth investments (programs) and short-term impactful moments (campaigns), measuring success in both. Brand Toolkit Development – Create toolkits that establish clear brand throughlines adaptable across markets. Creative Direction & Execution – Provide direction for all workstreams with an emphasis on world-class, immersive storytelling. Design Thinking Excellence – Apply a structured approach from inspiration to vision, concept, narrative, and customer journey development. Innovation & Brainstorming – Lead cross-functional creative brainstorms that leverage design thinking to unlock new approaches to brand activations. Brand Identity & Experiential Language – Collaborate with brand teams to define experiential brand language, including materials, textures, lighting, sounds, and more. Visualization & Presentation – Effectively communicate concepts through visualization and presentations to internal and external stakeholders. Creative Process Ownership – Manage projects from brief to execution, with a focus on concept visualization and execution. Design Execution & Aesthetic Excellence – Demonstrate expertise in defining all design elements, including identity, typography, iconography, illustrations, animations, and more. Material & Fabrication Expertise – Establish a keen understanding of textures, fabrications, and physical materials that enhance brand storytelling. Leadership & Collaboration – Cultivate a reputation for leadership, reliability, and excellence while fostering a high-performance creative environment. Project Management & Execution – Balance creative vision with project management efficiency, ensuring timely and high-quality execution. Network Expansion – Build relationships with freelancers and agency partners to enhance creative output. Location, confirmed job-related skills, experience, and education will be considered in setting actual starting salary. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process. Bonus based on performance and eligibility target payout is 15% of annual salary paid out annually. Qualifications Education Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Experiential Design, or a related field. Additional certifications or coursework in branding, marketing, digital design, or experiential design is a plus. Experience Proven experience as a Brand Designer, Experiential Designer, or in a similar role leading multi-disciplinary design teams within an agency or in-house creative team. Experience in leading small teams, fostering collaboration, and driving innovative design solutions. A strong portfolio showcasing immersive brand experiences, environmental design, digital interactions, and branding projects. Core Skills Experiential Design & Execution – Expertise in designing and building immersive brand experiences that blend digital and physical interactions. Creative Team Leadership – Experience managing a team of mixed-trade designers (e.g., graphic designers, 3D artists, spatial designers, motion designers, and digital experience creators) to deliver compelling brand narratives. Digital & UI/UX Design Knowledge – Understanding of digital design best practices, including social media graphics, web design, and user interface/user experience principles. Product & Packaging Visualization – Ability to translate brand identity onto various packaging formats and 3D rendering or prototyping experience is a plus. Print Production Understanding – Familiarity with print production processes, color management, and pre-press procedures, particularly for packaging design. Storytelling & Narrative Building – Ability to craft compelling brand stories that resonate across multiple touchpoints. Cross-functional Collaboration – Strong communication and collaboration skills to effectively work with stakeholders across departments. As a Staff Platform Engineer at 2K, you are a visionary technical leader serving as the architect and champion of our internal developer ecosystems. AI Strategy & Execution:
Own the strategic roadmap and oversee the architectural delivery of our developer portal, utilizing AI and LLM-backed agentic workflows to automate complex environment bootstrapping, context-aware troubleshooting, and intent-driven infrastructure provisioning.
Technical Leadership:
Accountable for driving the technical strategic roadmap within Platform Engineering. Serve as the primary architectural advisor to engineering tech leads, consulting on core design strategies to ensure their services are built to leverage cloud-native Kubernetes patterns and advanced AI platform features effectively.
Platform Product Ownership:
Drive a "platform as a product" strategy, positioning the Internal Developer Platform (IDP) as the central hub of the developer experience. Partner with engineering leaders to deliver intuitive, frictionless, self-service capabilities that abstract away underlying infrastructure complexities and accelerate software delivery.
DevEx Strategy:
Collaborate with tech leads across different studios to identify systemic bottlenecks in the software development lifecycle, advising and steering teams on the design of automated solutions that elevate developer velocity, autonomy, and overall experience.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC):
Provide high-level architectural direction and governance to internal tech leads as they build and maintain modular, reusable Terraform libraries, ensuring standardized environment provisioning across multi-cloud and on-prem data centers.
Governance & Standards:
Define organization-wide standards for container orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, and service discovery within the Kubernetes ecosystem, partnering with engineering leads to ensure adoption and operational consistency.
Advanced Troubleshooting:
Provide Tier 2 support for complex platform-level issues, conducting deep-dive root cause analysis and implementing architectural changes to prevent systemic recurrence.
Operational Resilience & On-Call Strategy:
Establish and iterate on the incident management and escalation strategy. In this role, you will partner with engineering leads to define operational guardrails, SLA/SLO frameworks, and blameless post-mortem processes to ensure continuous platform availability and high operational maturity.

Deep Industry Experience:
10+ years of experience in Infrastructure, DevOps, or Platform Engineering, with at least 4+ years specifically focused on building internal developer platforms or Kubernetes-based tooling.
Kubernetes Expertise:
Expert-level mastery of Kubernetes architecture, cloud-native ecosystems, and internals such as operators, controllers, and CRDs.
Cloud Architecture:
Deep, expert-level experience with AWS and/or GCP, specifically managing highly elastic, mission-critical production workloads.
AI & Agentic Engineering Skills:
Proven foundational knowledge or hands-on experience incorporating Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI agents into automated engineering workflows, APIs, or platform tools.
Strong Programming Foundations:
Advanced proficiency in Go, Python, Java, or Rust, with a clear focus on building automation tools, Kubernetes operators, and developer-facing APIs.
Modern Tooling Mastery:
Complete mastery of Git, configuration management tools, and CI/CD platforms (such as GitHub Actions and ArgoCD) alongside expert-level Terraform utilization.
High-Availability by Design:
Proven ability to architect multi-region, high-availability systems capable of supporting global user bases.
Customer-First Mindset:
A strong "customer-first" behavioral mindset tailored to internal developer needs, combined with the ability to influence without authority across distributed teams and time zones.
Rotational Availability:
Willingness and ability to participate in a 24/7 rotational on-call schedule to maintain platform stability.
Bonus Items
Gaming Industry Background:
Prior experience in the gaming industry, specifically supporting large-scale, high-concurrency multiplayer backend services for AAA games.
Agentic Workflows:
Experience successfully driving an engineering organization through progressive maturity levels of agentic workflows (e.g., shifting from human-in-the-loop to autonomous hybrid operations).
